title: The Fremennik Trials
start: Speak to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall in Rellekka.

ironman.t: A means of obtaining a raw shark. Any of the following work:
In Aid of the Myreque for Temple Trekking
68 Fishing for swarm fishing spots in the Deep Sea Fishing hub
72 Thieving for the Ardougne Castle chests
76 Divination and Swan Song for transmuting Monkfish

items.t: A raw shark, raw manta ray or raw sea turtle (any of the three will work, and sharks are typically the cheapest)

recommended.t: Activated Fremennik Province and Seers' Village lodestone
Ring of recoil for lower-levelled players, in the fight against Koschei the deathless
Spirit terrorbird, (Super) energy potions, explorer's ring or other method of restoring energy
A player-owned house located at Rellekka, could save time (requires 30 Construction)

kills.t: Koschei the Deathless (without armour and weapons, in three forms – the fourth does not have to be killed, as letting it kill you will result in victory and no loss of items. They do not have a combat level.)

rewards.t: Ability to make an Enchanted lyre that can be used to teleport to the gates of Rellekka.
Access to the islands of Miscellania and Etceteria, along with access to the facilities in Rellekka.
A Fremennik blade (only if you killed Koschei the deathless the 4th time)
Ability to wear Berserker, Warrior, Farseer, and Archer helms.
Ability to wear Spined, Skeletal and Rock-shell armours.
Ability to see The Epic of Bukalla performance in the Rellekka longhall.
Ability to claim a new Pet rock by talking to Askeladden after the quest.
Bardur can now provide sharks in exchange for Fremennik blades, helms and shields

steps.t: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall in Rellekka. [Chat: 3 Do you have any quests? › Accept › 1 I want to become a Fremennik!]

sub.t: If Mountain Daughter has been completed but you never talked to Brundt the Chieftain after its completion: [Chat: 2 Talk about something else › 3 Do you have any quests? › Accept › 1 I want to become a Fremennik!]

steps.t: Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall next to Brundt. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Pick up a Keg of beer and beer (tankard) from one of the tables. This is a different item standard beer.
Talk to the Poison Salesman at Forester's Arms in Seers' Village. [Chat: 2 Talk about the Fremennik Trials. › 1 Yes.]

sub.t: Buy a beer from the bartender nearby if you need one. The tankard from the previous step won't work.

steps.t: Use beer on council workman at the bridge south of Rellekka.
Light the strange object and put-inside pipe on the outside eastern wall of the Rellekka longhall.
p: A player having their lyre enchanted

steps.t: Enter the longhall. Use low alcohol keg on the keg of beer in the backpack.
Challenge Manni. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Speak to Olaf the Bard, who is located east of the longhall. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Travel south-east to the swaying tree, north-west of the Golden Apple Tree on the world map, surrounded by rabbits and doogle leaves.
Chop off a branch and craft it into an unstrung lyre.
Head south-east and talk to Lalli. [Chat: 1 Other human?]
Talk to Askeladden south of the longhall.
Grab a raw potato, an onion, and cabbage from the farm in south-east Rellekka. It's recommended to pick an extra onion and cabbage in case you accidentally eat them.
"Use" the potato, onion, cabbage, and pet rock on Lalli's Stew.
Talk to Lalli to obtain a golden fleece.

sub.t: Use the drop trick to obtain another if you plan on completing Kili's Knowledge VII.

steps.t: "Use" the golden fleece on a spinning wheel to make golden wool. There's one in south-west Rellekka.
Use the wool on the unstrung lyre.
Use your raw shark, manta ray or sea turtle on the strange altar south-west of Rellekka.
Enter the backstage of the longhall through the north-east door. Play the enchanted lyre in front of the crowd. You will receive Olaf's vote.
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman near Rellekka's southern entrance. [Chat: 1 What's a Draugen? › 1 Yes.]

Use the received hunters' talisman to locate and kill The Draugen. The Draugen is not visible until you get close to his location. Look for a tiny grey butterfly. There are only a few of these, one of which is the Draugen. Once in melee distance of the butterfly, use the 'Locate' function on the talisman once again, The Draugen will appear.
Return to Sigli to receive his vote.
Talk to Sigmund The Merchant in the marketplace. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to the Sailor on the middle dock. Right-click and select Talk, as Travel is the default option [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to Olaf the Bard, east of the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to Yrsa in the clothing store, just west of the marketplace. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman south of the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to Skulgrimen in the helmet store just north of the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to the Fisherman on the first dock west of the helmet store. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to Swensen the Navigator in a house south of the market. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]

Talk to Peer the Seer west of Swensen. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial] or [Chat: 2 The Fremennik Trials › 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial] if you've completed the easy Fremennik achievements
Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in the helmet store. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Talk to Askeladden outside the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial › 1 Yes]
Give the promissory note to Thora in the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the legendary cocktail to Manni in the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the champions token to Thorvald in the helmet store. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]

Give the warriors' contract to Peer southwest of the market. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial] or [Chat: 2 The Fremennik Trials › 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial] if you've completed the easy Fremennik achievements
Give the weather forecast to Swensen east of Peer. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the sea fishing map to the Fisherman on the first dock west of the helmet store. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the unusual fish to Skulgrimen in the helmet store. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the custom bowstring to Sigli south of the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the tracking map to Brundt in the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the fiscal statement to Yrsa in the clothing store, just west of the marketplace. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the sturdy boots to Olaf east of the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the Fremennik ballad to the Sailor on the middle dock. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Merchant's Trial]
Give the exotic flower to Sigmund in the marketplace. You will receive his vote.
Talk to Swensen the Navigator in his house south-west of the longhall. [Chat: 1 Yes]

Go down the ladder in the small room in his house. In each room, there are four portals. Enter them in the correct order to receive his vote. The first letter of each direction spells out the name SWENSEN. The correct order is as follows:

sub.t: South
West
East
North
South
East
North

p: A player in the maze of Swensen the Navigator

steps.t: Climb up the ladder, then talk to Swensen to receive his vote.

Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in the helmet store north of the longhall. [Chat: 1 Yes.] In order to receive his vote, you must kill a special warrior called Koschei the Deathless. However, the fight has three rules:
: You must defeat him at least three out of four times.
: You must fight to the death.

: You are not allowed to use weapons or armour or beasts of burden. This also means no runes, staves, etc (you can use food, prayer, rings of recoil, already summoned familiars, a pickaxe or hatchet removed from your tool belt, or even a dismantled godsword).
Climb down the ladder and wait for him to appear to begin the fight.
Defeat him three times and either kill him the fourth time or let yourself be defeated. (You will not die).
Talk to Thorvald to receive his vote.
Speak to Peer the Seer, who can be found south-west of the market in Rellekka. [Chat: 1 Yes.] or [Chat: 2 The Fremennik Trials › 1 Yes] if you've completed the easy Fremennik achievements

To enter his house, you must solve a simple riddle. The riddle gives hints to letters in a four-letter word. Possible answers include: "tree", "time", "life", "mage", "fire", "wind", "mind" and "disk".
Enter the building and climb the ladder.

sub.t: Study the unicorn's head for an old red disk.
Study the bull's head for a wooden disk.
Search the bookcase for a red herring.
Open then search the eastern chest for an empty jug.
Open then search the south-west cupboard for an empty bucket.

steps.t: Use the red herring on the cooking range to get sticky red goop.
Use the goop on the wooden disk to get a second red disk.
Go down the eastern trapdoor and use the two disks on the abstract mural for a vase lid.
Climb the ladder.

sub.t: Use the empty jug on the tap, then the full jug on the empty bucket.
Use the empty jug on the tap again and fill the bucket. You'll have a full bucket and a 1/3rds full jug.
Use the full bucket on the drain to get an empty bucket. Or search the cupboard again.
Use the 1/3rds full jug on the empty bucket.
Use the empty jug on the tap, then use the full jug on the 1/5ths full bucket to get a 4/5ths full bucket.
Use the 4/5ths full bucket on the northwestern chest to receive a vase.
Use the vase on the tap.
Use the vase lid on the vase of water to get a sealed vase.

steps.t: Use the sealed vase on the frozen table to receive a frozen key.
Use the frozen key on the range, then go down the eastern trapdoor again and out the exit. You will receive Peer the Seer's vote.
Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall in Rellekka.
Congratulations, quest complete!
